verdict.rationale: Solid's own README states that it is web component friendly and can author custom elements, so the product itself directly claims the capability in the story. The evidence is only a single feature-list line, with no usage details or hands-on reports. Missing for 10: documentation of how custom elements are authored (APIs, Shadow DOM, attribute/prop reflection, lifecycle), independent or hands-on corroboration of authoring web components with Solid.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author standards-based web components and custom elements using the framework

citations.quote: Web component friendly and can author custom elements
